basic_profile.bio: A tech-savvy DIY enthusiast in their mid-20s, based in Portland, Oregon. I love exploring new gadgets, especially those that blend cooking with technology, like air fryers and instant pots. When I'm not experimenting in the kitchen, I enjoy building custom setups for my Nintendo Labo or tinkering with smart home mirrors. My online activity peaks in the evenings and weekends. I work as a junior software developer and am currently single, enjoying the freedom to travel and explore new hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Primarily self-taught with a focus on technology and DIY projects. I have a bachelor's degree in computer science and have learned a lot through online forums and YouTube tutorials. My curiosity drives me to constantly learn and try out new things, especially in the realm of tech gadgets and their practical applications.
